Montgomery County is Houston's affluent northern suburb, built around Conroe, The Woodlands master-planned community and Lake Conroe. It has ranked among the fastest-growing large counties in the country for years, with corporate campuses along I-45 and the Grand Parkway, and MUD district boundaries plus Lake Conroe frontage are the two things that most move land value here.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 12, 2026
